movies.tagline: Billie Eilish and James Cameron reinvent the concert experience.

movies.title: Die Tribute von Panem - The Hunger Games
movies.criticTitle: Die Tribute von Panem - The Hunger Games
sourceTitles: Die Tribute von Panem - The Hunger Games
movies.plot: In a dystopian society where the Capitol forces each district to send two young tributes to fight to the death in a televised spectacle, a girl volunteers to take her sister’s place, setting the stage for a struggle of survival and defiance.

movies.title: Vertigo - Aus dem Reich der Toten
movies.criticTitle: Vertigo - Aus dem Reich der Toten
sourceTitles: Vertigo - Aus dem Reich der Toten
movies.plot: A retired San Francisco detective suffering from acrophobia investigates the strange activities of an old friend's wife, all the while becoming dangerously obsessed with her.
movies.tagline: Alfred Hitchcock engulfs you in a whirlpool of terror and tension!

movies.title: Üç Harfliler: Mühür
movies.plot: Fortune-teller Müzeyyen, a mansion filled with secrets and the darkness into which Fatma and her family are drawn...

movies.title: The Stories
movies.plot: The Stories is a decades-spanning Egyptian family saga and love story set between the late 1960s and 1980s. The film follows Ahmed, a young man from a Middle-Class Cairo family who dreams of becoming a concert pianist. During the tense summer of 1967, as war looms over Egypt, he begins a pen-pal correspondence with an Austrian woman named Elizabeth (“Liz”). A semi-autobiographical film based on the director's parents and how they met.

movies.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
movies.plot: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

movies.title: Onslaught
movies.plot: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.
movies.tagline: They unleashed their deadliest weapon on us.

movies.title: Lancelot, Ritter der Königin
movies.plot: Having failed in their quest for the Holy Grail, the knights of the Round Table return to Camelot, their number reduced to a mere handful. Seeing a rift developing between Lancelot and Mordred, Arthur urges his knights to bury their differences and become friends. However, the King is unaware that Lancelot is having an affair with his queen, Guinevere. Lancelot is torn between his duty to his king and his love for the queen, whilst Mordred is determined to use his infidelity to destroy him.

movies.title: Der Jazzsänger
movies.plot: A young Jewish man is torn between tradition and individuality when his old-fashioned family objects to his career as a jazz singer. This is the first full length feature film to use synchronized sound, and is the original film musical.
movies.tagline: Hear him sing Mammy, Toot Toot Tootsie, My Gal Sal, Mother I Still Have You.

movies.title: Der perfekte Schein - Der Fall Bojarski
movies.criticTitle: Der perfekte Schein - Der Fall Bojarski
sourceTitles: Der perfekte Schein - Der Fall Bojarski
movies.plot: A Polish engineer relocates to France and becomes a legendary counterfeiter. Working solo, he crafts flawless fake francs worth millions over 14 years, earning the nickname "Cézanne of counterfeit money" for his artistic skill and output.

movies.title: Chopin - Eine Sonate in Paris
movies.plot: He is the talk of the town, the most romantic figure of decadent Parisian nights. When his lungs start bleeding, Chopin knows his days are numbered. Composing becomes his only obsession. The ticking clock rushes him to revolutionize music.

movies.title: Dangerous Minds - Wilde Gedanken
movies.plot: Former Marine Louanne Johnson lands a gig teaching in a pilot program for bright but underachieving teens at a notorious inner-city high school. After having a terrible first day, she decides she must throw decorum to the wind. When Johnson returns to the classroom, she does so armed with a no-nonsense attitude informed by her military training and a fearless determination to better the lives of her students -- no matter what the cost.
movies.tagline: She broke the rules... and changed their lives.

movies.title: Dear You
movies.plot: Xiaowei travels to Thailand to find his "billionaire grandfather" who is out of contact due to debt problems, but unexpectedly find the one who has been corresponding with his grandmother for years is not her husband.

movies.title: Don't Trouble The Trouble
movies.plot: Suri, a magician, accidentally makes a young girl vanish with a spell. The girl, revealed to be a genie who grants wishes, explores the city and unleashes her powers when angered.

movies.title: Meesaya Murukku 2
movies.plot: After facing rejection in love and getting into a fight, Jeeva learns about his father Siva's struggles and sacrifices. Inspired by his grandfather's legacy and father's dedication, Jeeva changes his outlook and works hard toward his musical dream. Through determination and perseverance, Jeeva earns recognition in the music industry and brings pride to his family.

movies.title: Forgotten Island
movies.plot: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

movies.title: Runner
movies.plot: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

movies.title: Der Himmel über Berlin
movies.plot: Two angels, Damiel and Cassiel, glide through the streets of Berlin, observing the bustling population, providing invisible rays of hope to the distressed but never interacting with them. When Damiel falls in love with lonely trapeze artist Marion, the angel longs to experience life in the physical world, and finds — with some words of wisdom from actor Peter Falk — that it might be possible for him to take human form.
movies.tagline: There are angels on the streets of Berlin.

movies.title: Die vergessene Insel
movies.plot: 1908: Pascali, a spy for the Sultan, sends reports to Istanbul that nobody reads. His suspicions are roused when a British archaeologist appears, who may not be quite what he seems.
movies.tagline: At the end of an empire, a mystery began.

movies.title: Casablanca
movies.plot: In Casablanca, Morocco in December 1941, a cynical American expatriate meets a former lover, with unforeseen complications.
movies.tagline: They had a date with fate in Casablanca!

movies.title: Dokumentarfilm
movies.plot: Documentary observes lessons in a ballet school. Between the fun of dance and the discipline and perseverance that each of the dancers brings to it, the film shows different age groups in their practice process. Because behind the graceful perfection on the theater stage lies a long and arduous path.

movies.title: Valerie - Eine Woche voller Wunder
movies.plot: Valerie, a Czechoslovakian teenager living with her grandmother, is blossoming into womanhood, but that transformation proves secondary to the effects she experiences when she puts on a pair of magic earrings. Now seeing the world around her in a different light, Valerie must endure her sexual awakening while attempting to discern reality from fantasy as she encounters lecherous priest Gracian, a vampire-like stranger and otherworldly carnival folk.
movies.tmdbTitle: Valerie and Her Week of Wonders

movies.title: OASIS: Don't Look Back In Anger
sourceTitles: OASIS: Don't Look Back In Anger
movies.originalTitle: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
movies.plot: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.
movies.tmdbTitle: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger

movies.title: Hope
movies.plot: Together for 20 years, a couple that has grown apart over time receives difficult news that will impact the entire family. As they try to make sense of the changes, they end up rediscovering their love for one another.
movies.tagline: What about love when you have three months left to live?

movies.title: Lügen über meine Mutter
movies.plot: In the 1980s, the life of a family in a small village is determined by just one issue: the mother's body weight. Her husband Werner decides that she needs to lose weight, Cornelia suffers as a result and their daughter Ela is caught in the middle.

movies.title: Eine Krankheit wie ein Gedicht
movies.plot: Jelena Ilić's father suffers from drug-induced psychosis and has been in forensic psychiatry for five years. Now the day of his release is approaching. How can the director be sure that her father will not relapse and become violent again? How can a reconciliation be achieved? And how can society successfully reintegrate a mentally ill offender?

movies.title: Lethal Weapon 4
movies.plot: With personal crises and age weighing in on them, LAPD officers Riggs and Murtaugh must contend with a deadly Chinese crime lord trying to get his brother out of prison.

movies.title: An Unfinished Film
movies.altTitle: Yi bu wei wancheng de dianying
movies.plot: A film crew gathers in a hotel near Wuhan to resume production of a film that was interrupted ten years earlier, but an unexpected event once again disrupts the preparations.

movies.title: Yanuni
movies.plot: Indigenous chief Juma Xipaia fights to protect tribal lands despite assassination attempts. Her struggle intensifies after learning she's pregnant, while her husband, Special Forces ranger Hugo Loss, stands by her side.

movies.title: Boulevard der Dämmerung
movies.plot: A hack screenwriter writes a screenplay for a former silent film star who has faded into Hollywood obscurity.
